set-name readings: indent none|one_em|one_or_one_half_em (1 em; +1/2 em before a paragraph-initial opening bracket); groups uke = closing brackets + commas, period = full stops, all = both; one_half_em = half-width at line end, one_em = full-width fixed, no_float = unfixed (1/2 em compressible to none); unnamed groups: uke_one_half_em keeps full stops unfixed, uke_no_float sets full stops half-width, period_one_em sets uke half-width; Chinese defaults indent 2 em

STU-TYP-137 gives no default contents: shipped hard_kinsoku/soft_kinsoku from JLREQ 3.1.7 (hard: cl-02..07, 09..11 cannot begin; soft: cl-02, 04..07; both: cl-01 cannot end, cl-08 inseparable, comma + full stop hang)
bunri_kinshi characters read as U+2025, U+2026, U+2E40
kinsoku_hang_type and burasagari_type map to one hang mode (none / optional / forced, stronger wins); kinsoku_order used only as the prioritize_adjustment tie rule in single_line scope
kinsoku_type in every_line scope is a penalty bias (KINSOKU_BIAS 50) on the disfavoured break, push_out_only removes aki shrink; HANG_COST 100 for optional hangs
paragraph kinsoku attributes stored on per-paragraph-style bindings (no local paragraph override); composer without a kinsoku table = no kinsoku; without a mojikumi table = nothing
